## Where the data would come from

**This project vendors no game data, and that is not negotiable.** Ascension,
talent, weapon and material figures must come from first-hand observation or
from hand-authored public fact; nothing is lifted from a datamined dump or a
wiki, and every wrapper library surveyed so far wraps HoYoverse-copyright data
that its own licence cannot grant rights to. See `docs/LICENSE_NOTES.md`.

So if your request needs data the project does not have, please say where you
believe it would legitimately come from. A request that can only be met by
vendoring a dataset will be closed with that reason.

- [ ] This needs no new data source.
- [ ] This needs a new data source, described below.

## Has it already been decided?

Architectural decisions are indexed in `docs/adr/README.md`, several of which
record options that were considered and refused. If your request reverses one,
say which and what is new since - a proposal that engages with the record is far
more likely to land than one that reopens it from scratch.
